queries: SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(L.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(L.HCT) IS NULL) ASC, AVG(L.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies if they have at least one lab record with U-PRO = '-' and at least one (possibly different) lab record with RA = '-'; the averages then cover all of the patient's lab records, not just the qualifying ones.

alternatives.interpretation: Both '-' results must occur in the same lab record; averages are still computed over all of the patient's lab records.
